name: SF Keyboard

localizedDescriptions.zh: SF Symbols 图标键盘：按分类浏览，点按输入图标名，长按复制 PNG。支持导入 SF Symbols.app 的数据更新图标列表。
localizedDescriptions.en: An SF Symbols keyboard: browse by category, tap to insert a symbol name, long press to copy a PNG. Import SF Symbols.app metadata to update the list.

description: An SF Symbols keyboard: browse by category, tap to insert a symbol name, long press to copy a PNG.
